shop.introDefault: Every Gandhi Brothers formulation, made the right way in Junagadh and shipped across India.
shop.introChurna: Churnas are finely-ground herbal powders — the oldest and most versatile form in Ayurveda. Each of ours is prepared in small batches from carefully sourced dravyas, sieved to a consistent grade, and packed under our FDCA licence in Junagadh. Choose your pack size on any product below.
shop.introTaila: Tailas are medicated oils, prepared by slow-cooking herbs into a base oil so their properties carry through. Ours follow classical methods under our FDCA licence in Junagadh. Browse the range below and pick the size that suits you.

home.heroSubtitle: For three generations, our family has stood behind the counter in Junagadh, sharing the healing wisdom of Ayurveda. Today, we bring those same authentic, time-tested formulations directly to you—carefully crafted, FDCA-certified, and made the right way.
home.staplesSubtitle: These are the preparations our community has trusted for decades. Made in small, careful batches to ensure every pouch and bottle meets the standards our grandfather set.
home.catalogueLoading: Catalogue loading — please check back shortly.
home.offerBody: We believe that genuine wellness comes from pure ingredients and centuries of wisdom. Explore our complete catalogue of classical formulations, properly prepared and delivered straight to your home across India.
home.t1Quote: I have prescribed Gandhi Brothers Triphala for two years. The granulation, taste and consistency are exactly what classical preparation should be.
home.t2Quote: Three generations of my family have bought medicines from JGV in Junagadh. The new manufacturing brand carries that same standard.
home.t3Quote: Their compliance discipline is rare in this industry — proper batch numbers, traceable raw materials, FDCA paperwork in order.
